What is T2W Fit Studio?: T2W Fit Studio is a coaching-based fitness and performance training facility in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma that helps adults and athletes improve strength, conditioning, mobility, performance, and overall health through structured programs and expert coaching.
What services do you offer?: We offer Team Training Classes, Personal Training, Buddy Training, Speed, Agility & Performance (SPA) Training, Basketball Skills Training, T2W Elite Basketball Development, Nutrition Coaching, InBody Scans, Open Gym Access, and the T2W Fit Training App.
Do I need to be in shape before joining?: No. Our programs are designed for all fitness levels. Whether you're just getting started or looking to take your performance to the next level, our coaches can help.
Do you offer personal training?: Yes. We offer one-on-one and buddy training sessions customized to your goals, fitness level, and schedule.
What is Open Gym?: Open Gym allows approved members and pass holders to train independently during designated Open Gym hours. Open Gym is intended for self-directed workouts and does not include coaching or instruction.
How does Open Gym access work?: Members must reserve Open Gym sessions through the T2W Fit app or booking system. Access may include digital entry credentials, temporary access codes, or staff-assisted entry depending on membership type and facility policies.
Are there rules for Open Gym?: Yes. All participants must check in before training, follow posted facility rules, re-rack equipment after use, respect other members, avoid tailgating or allowing unauthorized guests inside, and follow all safety guidelines. Failure to follow Open Gym policies may result in loss of access privileges.
How do I get started?: The easiest way to get started is by completing our contact form or signing up for a free trial. A coach will reach out to discuss your goals and recommend the best program for you.
What should I bring to my first workout?: Bring comfortable workout clothes, athletic shoes, a water bottle, and a positive attitude. We'll guide you through the rest.
Do you offer a free trial?: Select programs may include a free trial or introductory offer. Contact us for current promotions and availability.
What is the T2W Fit Training App?: The T2W Fit Training App provides access to workouts, coaching, progress tracking, nutrition support, accountability tools, and on-demand training from anywhere.
Do you offer programs for athletes?: Absolutely. Our Speed, Agility & Performance (SPA) and T2W Elite programs help athletes improve speed, power, strength, agility, conditioning, and sport-specific performance.
What is wellness coaching?: Wellness coaching looks beyond just your workouts. We evaluate your sleep, stress, hydration, nutrition, and recovery to create a comprehensive plan for better health.
Do I need an InBody scan?: We highly recommend it. It gives us the data we need to personalize your approach and track your real progress over time.
Which stack is right for me?: Take the Wellness Assessment or speak with one of our coaches to get a personalized recommendation.
How often should I retest?: We recommend an InBody scan every 4-6 weeks to track your progress and adjust your wellness plan as needed.
Can beginners participate?: Absolutely. Our wellness ecosystem is designed to meet you where you are, whether you're just starting out or looking to optimize your current routine.
How long does the assessment take?: The online assessment takes less than 60 seconds to complete. You'll receive your recommendation immediately.
Is this really free?: Yes! Our online wellness assessment is 100% free and is designed to help point you in the right direction.
What happens after I complete the assess: You'll receive a personalized recommendation for the best T2W program for your goals, plus the option to book a free consultation or InBody scan.
How long does an InBody scan take?: The scan itself takes less than 60 seconds. The entire appointment, including reviewing your results with a coach, takes about 15-20 minutes.
Do I need to fast?: For the most accurate results, we recommend fasting for 2-3 hours prior, avoiding exercise before the scan, and maintaining normal hydration.
How often should I scan?: We recommend scanning every 4-6 weeks to accurately track your progress and make necessary adjustments to your program.
Is my first scan free?: Yes! We offer a complimentary first InBody scan to help you establish your baseline and set clear, measurable goals.
How accurate is InBody?: InBody uses advanced Direct Segmental Multi-frequency Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis (DSM-BIA), making it one of the most accurate body composition analyzers available.
How much sleep do I need?: Most adults need 7-9 hours of quality sleep per night for optimal recovery, hormone regulation, and cognitive function. Athletes may need even more.
How much water should I drink?: A general baseline is half your body weight in ounces per day, plus additional hydration to replace fluids lost during exercise.
Can recovery improve fat loss?: Absolutely. Poor recovery elevates cortisol, which can increase fat storage and cravings. Proper sleep and stress management are essential for sustainable fat loss.
How often should I retest InBody?: We recommend scanning every 4-6 weeks to accurately track your progress and ensure your recovery protocols are working.
What stack is best for recovery?: The Recovery & Joint stack is ideal for physical recovery, while the Sleep & Stress stack is best if you struggle to wind down or get quality rest.
Is strength training safe for beginners?: Absolutely. Our programs are coach-led, meaning we teach you proper form, modify movements to your ability, and progress you safely as you build confidence.
How often should women complete InBody s: We recommend scanning every 4-6 weeks to track your muscle mass, body fat percentage, and hydration levels accurately without obsessing over the daily scale.
Can strength training improve metabolism: Yes! Building lean muscle mass increases your basal metabolic rate (BMR), meaning your body burns more calories at rest, making long-term fat loss more sustainable.
What wellness stack is best for me?: It depends on your goals. Women's Performance is great for active individuals, while Hormone Optimize or Sleep & Stress can help with recovery and balance. Take our Wellness Assessment for a personalized recommendation.
Which T2W program should I start with?: Team Build or Personal Training are excellent starting points for establishing a safe baseline, learning proper mechanics, and progressively building strength.
Why is muscle important after 40?: Muscle mass naturally declines with age (sarcopenia). Maintaining muscle supports your metabolism, protects your joints, improves balance, and is a key predictor of longevity and independence.
Can strength training improve longevity?: Yes. Consistent strength training improves bone density, regulates blood sugar, reduces injury risk, and enhances overall quality of life as you age.
How often should I complete an InBody sc: We recommend scanning every 4-6 weeks to track your muscle mass preservation, body fat percentage, and hydration levels accurately.
What supplements support healthy aging?: Our Longevity 40+ stack and Foundational Health stack provide the essential nutrients, antioxidants, and cellular support needed for healthy aging.
Which T2W program is best for beginners: Team Build or Personal Training are excellent starting points. They focus on movement quality, establishing a safe baseline, and progressively building strength.
Do I need supplements?: Supplements fill the gaps in your nutrition. While whole foods come first, targeted supplements can help you reach your goals faster and support optimal health.
Why Thorne?: Thorne provides the highest quality, purest, and most bioavailable supplements on the market, trusted by professional athletes and health practitioners.
How do I know which stack is right for m: Take our Wellness Assessment or book an InBody scan to get a personalized recommendation.
What is corporate wellness?: Corporate wellness refers to programs and activities designed to support and improve the health, fitness, and overall well-being of employees within an organization.
Can you come to our office?: Yes! We offer on-site services including InBody events, Lunch & Learn sessions, and fitness workshops.
How many employees are required?: We work with organizations of all sizes, from small teams of 5 to large corporations with 50+ employees.
How long does an InBody event take?: A typical InBody scan takes less than a minute per person. We can efficiently process large groups while providing individual result reviews.
Can we customize wellness programs?: Absolutely. We tailor our challenges, workshops, and coaching to fit your team's specific goals and company culture.
When should athletes start strength trai: Athletes can begin structured, age-appropriate strength training as early as 8-10 years old, focusing on bodyweight control, mobility, and movement mechanics before adding external loads.
Do athletes need supplements?: While whole foods should always come first, supplements like protein, hydration formulas, and recovery stacks can help fill nutritional gaps during intense training and competition seasons.
How often should athletes complete InBod: We recommend athletes complete an InBody scan every 4-8 weeks depending on their training phase (off-season vs. in-season) to monitor muscle retention and hydration.
How is T2W Elite different?: T2W Elite focuses on competitive basketball team development, exposure, and advanced skill application in game scenarios, rather than just individual skill work.
How is SPA different?: Speed, Agility & Performance (SPA) is sport-agnostic. It focuses purely on making athletes faster, more explosive, and more agile regardless of the sport they play.
What age should my athlete start trainin: Athletes can begin foundational movement and coordination training as early as 8-10 years old. We focus on bodyweight control and mechanics before adding resistance.
Do young athletes need strength training: Yes, when done properly. Age-appropriate strength training is safe and highly effective for injury prevention, building bone density, and improving overall athleticism.
How often should athletes train?: For optimal development without overtraining, we typically recommend 2-3 sessions per week, depending on their current sports season and schedule.
What sports benefit from this training?: All sports! We build general athleticism (speed, strength, coordination, and power) which transfers to basketball, football, soccer, baseball, volleyball, and more.
Can my child join regular classes?: Children ages 12-17 may participate after completing an assessment and receiving coach approval.
Does a parent have to be a member?: Yes. Family Add-Ons require an active parent membership.
Can my child use Open Gym?: Only with coach approval or parent supervision.
What if my child is an athlete?: Young athletes can also train through our Speed, Agility & Performance (SPA), Basketball Skills, private, and buddy training options.
How do I join a challenge?: Ask a coach during your next studio visit or check the T2W Fit Training App for current member challenges.
How do referrals work?: Refer a friend who joins T2W Fit Studio or T2W Elite Basketball and you earn 100 Rewards Points. Submit your referral on our Refer & Earn page.
How do I access resources?: All free guides, including nutrition guides and cookbooks, are available in the Resource Library below.
What are my member benefits?: As a T2W member, you get access to exclusive challenges, partner discounts, early event registration, and our wellness tools.
Can beginners succeed?: Absolutely. Our programs are designed to meet you where you are. We offer modifications and progressions to ensure everyone can succeed safely.
How long before I see results?: While everyone is different, most members start feeling better within 2 weeks. Measurable changes in strength and body composition typically appear within 4-6 weeks of consistent training.
How often should I do an InBody scan?: We recommend an InBody scan every 4-6 weeks to track your progress and adjust your training and nutrition as needed.
Which program should I start with?: Team Build is our recommended starting point for most new members, focusing on foundational movement patterns and building work capacity.
Can I switch programs?: Yes! Our programs are designed as a progression. As you build strength and capacity, you can transition from Build to Sweat to Flex.
What if I'm new?: That's exactly why we're here! Our beginner-friendly programs, like Team Build, are designed to teach you the fundamentals safely.
Which program is best for weight loss?: Team Sweat combined with our Metabolic Energy stack and nutritional guidance is our most effective approach for fat loss.
Which program is best for strength?: Team Flex is designed specifically for building lean muscle, increasing strength, and improving overall power.
How do supplements fit into the plan?: Supplements fill the gaps in your nutrition. We recommend specific Thorne stacks based on your goals to accelerate your results.
How long can I pause my membership?: You can pause for up to 3 months. Pauses are available for Studio memberships. App-only plans are not eligible for a pause.
Do I keep my membership rate when I resu: Yes. A pause keeps your current membership price, including any grandfathered rate. When your pause ends, your membership resumes at the same price you started at.
Will I be billed while my membership is: A $10 hold fee is charged for each month of the pause. This is what keeps your current membership price locked in. Your regular membership charge is suspended during the pause.
Can I access classes or Open Gym during: Membership benefits, including class access, Open Gym, and the T2W Fit App, are suspended while your membership is on hold. You'll regain full access the day your membership resumes.
What if I want to resume earlier than pl: No problem. Just let us know and we can end your pause early so you can get back to training sooner. Reach out through the form above or contact us directly.
Is there a fee to pause my membership?: Yes. The pause fee is $10 per month of the pause. Pause requests must be submitted at least 30 days before your next subscription charge; requests submitted inside that window take effect after your next billing date.
What is your cancellation policy?: We require a formal cancellation request submitted through this form. A team member will review and finalize your cancellation. Depending on your membership type, a notice period of up to 30 days may apply. You'll receive confirmation once your cancellation has been processed.
Will I still be billed after submitting: Submitting this form is a request to cancel, not an instant cancellation. Any applicable notice period and final billing cycle will be confirmed by a team member before your cancellation is finalized.
Can I cancel in person or over the phone: For your protection and our records, cancellations must be submitted in writing through this form. This ensures we have a clear record of your request and can process it accurately.
What happens to my membership rate if I: If you cancel and rejoin at a later date, you'll enroll at the current membership rates available at that time. Previous rates cannot be guaranteed after a cancellation is finalized.
Do I lose access immediately after cance: You retain full membership access through the end of your final paid billing cycle. Your access will end once your cancellation is finalized and your last billing period concludes.
Is there a cancellation fee?: Cancellation fees depend on your membership type and any remaining term commitments. A team member will review your specific plan and confirm any applicable fees before finalizing your cancellation.
Can I pause my membership instead of can: Yes! If you're dealing with a temporary situation like travel, injury, or a busy season, we may be able to pause your membership instead. Visit our pause request page to submit a hold instead of a full cancellation.
